{{Quote|Mother liked being regent after father's death, and she and my Uncle did not get along.|Adan Dooku to Bail Organa|<ref name="AotE:HT" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''noble''' of [[House Dooku]] served as the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great House's]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While Count, he was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a woman named [[Kostanza Dooku|Kostanza]], with whom he had a child, [[Adan Dooku]]. However, during his son's childhood the count died, leaving his son to take his place as the new count. Because of Adan's youth, his mother acted as regent. Adan and Kostanza eventually left Serenno in self-[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] upon the arrival of [[Dooku/Legends|Adan's uncle]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who claimed the title of count for himself.<ref name="AotE:HT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dooku's brother was first mentioned in the comic-book series ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' in the [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]], the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets|Hard Targets]] story arc, published on [[October 17]], [[2012]].
